jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
Misr Capital Expo is a growing financial services organization focused on delivering innovative working capital investment solutions to a diverse range of clients.

Role Description
The Senior Financial Analyst role at Misr Capital Expo is a full-time, on-site position based in Giza. The Financial Analyst will review and interpret financial data, prepare regular financial reports, and analyze financial statements to support management decisions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting financial planning and forecasting, evaluating business performance, identifying trends and variances, providing recommendations to improve financial outcome, as well as working closely with the Business Development Department. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, contributing to budgeting processes, and ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of financial information. The Financial Analyst is expected to maintain high attention to detail, follow established procedures, and support strategic initiatives with well-structured financial analysis.

Qualifications

• Strong Finance knowledge and experience working with Financial Statements.
• Advanced Analytical Skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data.
• Experience in Financial Planning, including budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
• Proficiency in Financial Reporting, ensuring accurate and compliant reports.
• Strong numerical aptitude and proficiency with spreadsheets and financial modeling tools.
• Effective communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to non-financial stakeholders.
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CMA) are a plus.
• 2-5 years experience as a Financial Analyst.
• Ability to work on-site in Giza, manage multiple priorities, and maintain ethical standards and confidentiality.

Please email your resume to info@mc-expo.com
